_comment: Per-app settings for the playbook's play_policy_insights.py (falcon: playbook/skills/play-policy-guard). That checker was written for an Expo repo: its APK checks (package, target API, permissions against this allowlist, debuggable, AD_ID, 16 KB alignment) work on this app's builds as they are; its source-code checks look for TypeScript and do not apply. The Kotlin-side equivalents are unit tests here: ManifestPermissionsTest, LaunchGateTest and ProductTextTest. The listing, Data safety and graphics paths below are where those files will live at launch; they do not exist yet.
_allowed_permissions_why: POST_NOTIFICATIONS for the optional handled-call, report and milestone notifications. RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED so the daily report check survives a restart (WorkManager wants it; the ads SDK strips it, so the app declares it). WAKE_LOCK and an untyped FOREGROUND_SERVICE come from WorkManager. INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, AD_ID and the three ADSERVICES permissions come from the Google Mobile Ads SDK. BILLING comes from the Google Play Billing Library, for the two paid plans (ADR-009). Deliberately absent: contacts, call log, phone state, SMS (ADR-002, ADR-003).
